Hi Emma / Andrew,

Thanks for taking the call yesterday. As discussed, Redwood would love to co-host a short (40–50m) webinar aimed at product and security leaders at healthtech firms on practical ways to run HIPAA-ready LLM inference. High-level goals: demand capture for mid-market healthcare prospects, highlight SecureHealth + Redwood joint capabilities, and gather quality SQLs.

Proposed timing: 3 weeks out — options: Tue Oct 28 or Tue Nov 3 (30–60 minute window). We intend to run a single 45m session with a 10–15m live Q&A.

Ask for you:
- Confirm preferred date (Oct 28 or Nov 3)
- Share the list segmentation you'd like us to target (customers vs prospects, role/title filters)
- Confirm whether you want SecureHealth to supply 1–2 short customer quotes (name & permission) for the slide deck

We can provide: co-branded registration page, RSVP tracking sheet (CSV), 2x subject-line variants for A/B, and an event deck. I'll loop Connor for tracking/links and Vivek for compliance slide inputs (SOC2/HIPAA evidence).

Attachments: (we'll finalize and send the deck once date confirmed)
